title: FEZrs: An Open-Source Python Package for Geospatial Multispectral Image Processing and Remote Sensing
description:
FEZrs is an open-source Python package for geospatial multispectral image processing and remote sensing. It puts thirty-seven operations (spectral indices, filters, image enhancement, GLCM texture, PCA, K-Means clustering, change detection and SVM classification) behind one three-line calling pattern. Each calculator can save a figure with execute() and a georeferenced GeoTIFF with to_raster().

Install with pip install fezrs or conda install -c FEZtool fezrs. Documentation: FEZdocs. Project page: feztool.com/fezrs.
